Camunda · BPMN & DMN

Grip on processes with many steps and exceptions.

Where low-code ends, orchestration begins. With Camunda (BPMN/DMN) we model processes that run for days, pass through several people and systems, and where every exception must be traceable.

Get in touchHow we work

Typical for this service

  • BPMN models business and IT read together
  • Decision rules explicit in DMN, not in code
  • Full history per process instance
  • Fit for audit and accountant review

What we deliver

From implicit process to monitored workflow.

01

Process modelling

Your process captured in BPMN: tasks, roles, deadlines and exception paths explicitly in view.

02

Decision rules in DMN

Limits, mandates and rate rules in manageable decision tables, adjustable without code.

03

System integration

Camunda orchestrates Exact Online and your other systems, with compensation when a step fails.

04

Audit trail

Every step, decision and waiting time recorded per instance. Traceable to the day.

How we work

Live in four steps.

No endless implementation. Up front it is clear what happens, who does what and what delivery includes, and after go-live you keep one fixed point of contact.

01

Quickscan

Processes, volumes and bottlenecks mapped, with a calculation of the expected saving.

02

Design

We design the flow around controls and auditability, and agree what delivery includes.

03

Build & onboarding

We build in short cycles, test against your real data and train your team on the result.

04

Maintenance

We maintain the solution and stay involved; new functionality becomes available automatically.
